primitives_used: btc_trend(period) - BTC market filter, returns >= 0 for bullish
vwap_distance(period) - Z-score distance from VWAP, < -1.0 = oversold
norm_rsi(period) - Normalized RSI (-1 to +1), < -0.1 = slightly oversold
strategy_logic: Mean reversion when SOL is significantly below VWAP during bullish BTC regime. Enter on oversold conditions, exit when price returns toward VWAP.
notes: T2 evolution result with 180-day data window. Outperformed ETH and BTC variants.
